supplementaryReferences.title: Edible part and local use
supplementaryReferences.quote: The whole fruit, including the seed, is edible
supplementaryReferences.note: The edible berry must be distinguished from bark, which the source describes as containing a poisonous glucoside.

care: Protect young plants from cold; use well-drained soil in sun or semi-shade. SANBI describes frost tenderness and tolerance of sea breezes.
purchase: Ask for botanically identified Carissa bispinosa and local provenance. The checked source supplies no named fruit cultivar.

sourceChecks.observations: Read indexed primary SANBI page content. Direct PlantZAfrica requests in this audit returned HTTP 403; this is not a claim that every individual endpoint was live-tested.

gaps: March–October is edible-berry production, not an explicitly measured ripe-picking interval; record the actual farm's ripe months. No ages or kg.
